title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands | TechCrunch
summary: Nectar , an AI-powered operating system for marketing, is launching a new AI agent designed to take a lot of the manual work out of influencer marketing, from finding the right creators to contacting them, managing partnerships, and tracking results.
